content.value: Why the starting torque of a squirrel-cage motor is poor? A 3-phase, slip-ring induction 13 13 motor with star-connected rotor has an induced emf of 120 volts between slip rings at standstill with normal voltage applied to the stator. The rotor winding has a resistance per phase of 0.3Ω and standstill leakage reactance per phase of 1.5Ω. Calculate:
(i) Rotor current/phase when running short-circuited with 4% slip and
(ii) The slip and rotor current/phase when rotor is developing maximum torque.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
